items.title: Delete a run's data on demand in Workflow SDK
items.summary: The  now lets you delete a finished run's stored data on demand. This feature gives you the ability to quickly meet compliance and security requirements when sensitive data needs to be purged from run payloads.Workflow SDKDeleting a run's data deletes any inputs, outputs, hook payloads, and error traces for the run and its related entities. This does  delete the run's : the run is still listed in observability. Attributes, hook tokens, and timings for steps and events can still be inspected.notmetadataYou can delete a run's data from the Vercel Dashboard, or via the CLI:You can also delete a run's data programmatically from your code:Deletion applies to finished runs only, so a run that is still going is skipped and keeps running. If you want to delete a run's payload as soon as it finishes, use the  instead.retention settingsUpgrade to  or higher to use this feature.
